reading.title: Marine Biodiversity and Climate Change
reading.passage: Ocean ecosystems are experiencing unprecedented changes due to rising water temperatures and increased carbon dioxide levels. Coral reefs, which support approximately 25% of marine species despite covering less than 1% of the ocean floor, are particularly vulnerable. When water temperatures rise, corals expel their symbiotic algae, leading to bleaching and potential death. Scientists estimate that if current warming trends continue, 90% of coral reefs could disappear by 2050. This would devastate countless species dependent on these ecosystems and threaten the food security of over one billion people who rely on marine biodiversity.

questions.q: According to the passage, what percentage of marine species do coral reefs support?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '산호초는 해양 면적의 1% 미만을 차지하지만 약 25%의 해양 생물종을 지원한다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What causes coral bleaching according to the passage?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 수온 상승으로 인해 산호가 공생 조류를 방출하여 표백이 일어난다고 설명합니다.

questions.q: How many people could be affected by coral reef disappearance?
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장에서 '10억 명이 넘는 사람들이 해양 생물 다양성에 의존한다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Technology has made human relationships weaker'? Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.

structure.intro: 관점을 명확히 제시하고 주요 논거 2-3개를 간단히 소개합니다. 예: 'While some argue technology weakens relationships, I believe it has strengthened human connections through new communication possibilities.'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 아이디어: 기술이 장거리 관계를 가능하게 하는 방식 설명. 구체적 예시 제시 (비디오 통화, SNS, 국제 연락 등)
structure.body2: 두 번째 아이디어: 반대 관점 인정하면서 균형잡힌 주장 제시. 예: 대면 상호작용의 중요성은 인정하되, 기술은 보조 도구라는 점 강조
structure.conclusion: 주요 관점을 재정리하고 기술 사용의 책임감 있는 활용을 강조하며 마무리합니다.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to live in big cities. Others prefer to live in small towns. Which do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons in your response.
sample_points: 도시의 장점: 더 나은 취업 기회, 문화시설(박물관, 극장), 다양한 사람들과의 만남, 교육 기관의 다양성
소도시의 장점: 느린 생활 속도, 더 강한 지역 공동체 의식, 낮은 생활비, 자연 환경 접근성, 범죄율 감소

listening.title: Campus Library Services
listening.script: Student: Hi, I'm looking for information about the library's research assistance program. Librarian: Oh sure! We offer several services for students conducting research. We have trained research librarians available by appointment who can help you find reliable sources for your papers. We also offer workshops every Tuesday and Thursday on topics like database searching, citation formats, and evaluating source credibility. Additionally, we have a new online chat service where you can ask questions 24/7. Many students find this particularly helpful when working on projects late at night. We also maintain a collection of over two million books and provide access to hundreds of academic databases. Student: That sounds really helpful. Are there any fees for these services? Librarian: No, all services are completely free for enrolled students. Your student ID is all you need. We want to make sure every student has equal access to quality research support, regardless of their financial situation.

questions.q: What research services does the library offer? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: 대화에서 도서관은 1) 예약을 통한 연구사서 상담, 2) 화요일과 목요일 워크숍, 3) 24시간 온라인 채팅 서비스를 모두 제공한다고 명시합니다.

questions.q: How many books does the library have in its collection?
questions.explanation: 사서가 'We maintain a collection of over two million books'라고 명확히 언급합니다.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the 24/7 online chat service?
options: B) To help students who work late at night on projects
D) To collect feedback from students
questions.explanation: 사서는 이 서비스가 '특히 밤늦게 프로젝트를 하는 학생들에게 유용하다'고 설명합니다.
